forms.title: BambooHR careers (fab- components, portal menus, dependent state list, pre-uploaded file ids)
quirks: form hidden behind 'Apply for This Job' on the job page (pushState ?apply)
fab-SelectToggle buttons over hidden inputs with numeric ids; menus render in a body-level portal (div.fab-MenuVessel) with a search box for long lists
State/Province options depend on the selected Country (default United States) and reset when it changes
fab-DatePicker: mm/dd/yyyy text input + calendar popover in the portal; submitted as yyyy-mm-dd
'Upload File' buttons over hidden file inputs; files upload immediately and only resumeFileId / coverLetterFileId are submitted
'Who referred you' must stay empty for a non-referral
inline fab-FormNote--error + aria-invalid; JSON XHR submit, then navigation to the confirmation
